scope: Checked CPU uint32 scalar literals, arithmetic, CLI entries and structured worker continuations.

semantics.types: Explicit uint32 values from zero through UINT32_MAX, with no implicit signed/float conversion. uint still aliases uint64; unconstrained int64/float64 defaults unchanged and unimplemented in this subset.
semantics.constants: Range-checked UInt32 literal IR and immutable constants. Multiplication is bounded before host signed multiplication can overflow. Negative/fractional/out-of-range literals, underflow, overflow and known zero divisors are diagnosed.
semantics.lowering: Zero-extend operands to 64 bits; checked unsigned add/multiply, subtraction operand-order guard, divui/remui after zero-divisor guard, and narrowing only after UINT32_MAX validation. No wrapping arithmetic.
semantics.negation: Unary plus preserves value. Unary minus preserves uint32 and succeeds only for zero; positive operand negation is an Arithmetic fault.
semantics.entries: Dedicated unsigned decimal CLI entry; existing signed and float entries unchanged.
semantics.tasks: Distinct unsigned/signed/float scalar keys and private layout IDs. Literal materialization and arithmetic continuations retain uint32 identity and checked MLIR lowering. Existing runtime, scheduler and checked invocation ABI unchanged.
semantics.faults: Child Arithmetic faults preserve source location and use existing TaskError.Fault supervision. Parent tensor reuse and a new parallel group remain valid after recovery.
semantics.gates: Uint32 tensors/operators/reductions/matmul, GPU arithmetic and numeric conversions remain unsupported. Frontend and backend tensor admission gates remain explicit.

coverage: separate frontend debug and ASan/UBSan checks
literal and immutable constant boundaries including UINT32_MAX squared
independent unsigned 64-bit reference over seven operations
10000 deterministic random input pairs per operation
unsigned multiplication with a product above signed int64 maximum
exact full-range unsigned CLI decimal values
ordinary forwarding and successful source worker arithmetic
uint32/int32/float32 roots and mixed capture packets with owned float tensors
all six faulting operations with original source locations
Arithmetic recovery with parent tensor reuse and a new group
uncaught synchronous/task failures and clean settlement
root allocation and invalid worker admission failure cleanup
static rejection preserves existing executable and IR
strict mixed-type/default rules and explicit uint32 tensor/GPU gates

distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design-review gate retained.
performance: Numeric correctness/type integration milestone; no performance improvement claim.
